headline: Airbnb (ABNB) Stock Still Looks Like A Bargain On A 26% Run
summary: Airbnb has delivered a 26.3% gain over the past year, yet its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate points to the stock trading at a roughly 29.8% discount, while the broader valuation checks still flag it as only a low-score value story. Airbnb's 26.3% return over the past year suggests investors have already priced in a fair amount of optimism.
